item.title: : Government of the Russian Federation Russian school students have already won 91 medals at international Olympiads this year!
item.description: Government of the Russian Federation : 🇷🇺 Russian school students have already won 91 medals at international Olympiads this year! Since the beginning of 2026, Russian national school teams have achieved outstanding results at international subject Olympiads. Russian students have also claimed overall winner titles. Russia’s Deputy Prime Minister Dmitry Chernyshenko highlighted Russian students’ achievements at international Olympiads so far this year. 👉 Russian students have already won 91 medals, including: 🥇 64 gold 🥈 26 silver 🥉 1 bronze Of these, 31 medals were won at the main Olympiads – the most demanding academic competitions. 💬 Russian Minister of Education Sergey Kravtsov said that Russian students had competed in six main and eight other international academic competitions in 2026: Every student returned home with a medal. Year after year, our school students demonstrate the high standard of Russian education at international academic competitions. In 2026, our teams continue their winning streak. The 60 medals won at other international subject Olympiads alone reflect both the students’ talent and hard work and the excellent work of their mentors. The 2026 Olympiad season will conclude in December , when the Russian team takes part in the 23rd International Junior Science Olympiad .

🎙
Remarks and answers to media questions
by Russia's Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov following talks with Minister of Foreign Affairs and Emigrants of Lebanon Youssef Raggi
(Moscow, October 12, 2026)
Key points
:
• In light of Israel’s ongoing actions in Lebanon, we reaffirmed Russia’s principled position
in support of the sovereignty, unity and territorial integrity of the Lebanese Republic
. We stand by our assessment that the Israeli army’s military actions f
lagrantly violate international law
and
provoke additional escalation in Lebanon
.
•
We share Beirut’s view that
the UN contingent should remain in southern Lebanon beyond 2026
, possibly in a different form and with different powers. The main point, however, is that its mandate must include maintaining peace and documenting any violations of
the UN Security Council resolution
.
🇷🇺
🇱🇧
#RussiaLebanon
:
We are both committed to
expanding political dialogue and strengthening our partnership
across various areas. Particular attention should be paid to trade and economic ties. To this end, we agreed to resume the work of
the Intergovernmental Russian-Lebanese Commission on Trade and Economic Cooperation
as soon as possible.
***
❓
Question (translated from Arabic)
:
The world, particularly Europe, is still reeling from the news of the “diesel deal” between Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump. Yesterday, the US President
announced
that an agreement had been reached to halt strikes on energy infrastructure in Ukraine and Russia. Has such an agreement actually been reached? Does Moscow support or confirm it? If so, what are its terms?
💬
Sergey Lavrov:
Regarding the status of this agreement,
we can refer to Zelensky’s reaction
. When asked the same question, he said he had not heard of such an agreement, would welcome clarification and was ready for a ceasefire.
He has said this many times. For many months now, the slogan of a “ceasefire” has replaced that of
“inflicting a strategic defeat on Russia”
in the rhetoric of both Zelensky and his Western “handlers”.
The aim is the same and very simple – to buy time and secure a respite.
His feigned surprise at President Donald Trump’s
statement
reveals just one thing: he is eager to seize on any words, initiatives or ideas that enter the public domain
to pursue, by fair means or foul, his goal of securing a respite
.
❗️
I do not think Zelensky has earned a respite. I do not think we will once again fall for assurances and promises.
President
Vladimir Putin
has made it very clear
that
we continue to pursue the objectives of
the special military operation
. Everyone knows exactly what they are. We have never changed them, unlike the twists and turns of Zelensky and his European “handlers”.
👉
We therefore have nothing to justify to anyone.

item.title: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova The Ukrainian blockade of Alyoshki
item.description: ⚡️ Russia's High Commissioner for Human Rights Yana Lantratova : The Ukrainian blockade of Alyoshki must be lifted to save civilian lives. People remain cut off from supplies of food, water and medicine. They include the elderly, women and children. We are in contact with the US Side and Melania Trump’s team , which has expressed its willingness to help the city, about this dire situation . Difficult negotiations are now underway to arrange the delivery of humanitarian supplies and the evacuation of people in urgent need of assistance. ❗️ The main cause of the humanitarian crisis is the blockade deliberately imposed by the Ukrainian armed forces. Ukrainian drones constantly patrolling the roads and remotely laid mines on roads and footpaths prevent aid from getting through. All supplies reaching Alyoshki today are carried by hand or brought in on bicycles by people risking their lives . According to available information, the most recent volunteer convoy, travelling in vehicles marked “People”, was destroyed by Ukrainian strikes . If the Ukrainian side stopped attacking and mining the routes used to supply the city’s residents, essential aid could be delivered and those in urgent need could be evacuated . ☝️ We will help all residents, regardless of their political views. People are our highest priority, and the value of every human life is unconditional. Russia will do everything possible to save civilian lives.

item.title: ⚡️ Press release on the October 10 strikes at Riyadh international airport (October 11, 2026)
item.description: ⚡️ Press release on the October 10 strikes at Riyadh international airport (October 11, 2026) According to incoming information, on October 10 the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh was subject to a massive missile strike. ▪️ The attack resulted in the death of 12 people , including citizens of Saudi Arabia, Bangladesh, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Palestine, Sudan and the United States. More than 300 people sustained injuries of varying severity. According to preliminary reports from the Embassy of Russia in Saudi Arabia there are no Russian compatriots among the victims. Moscow expresses its deep condolences to the families and friends of those killed and wishes speedy recovery to the wounded. ❗️ Russia condemns this attack and calls on the parties to the conflict on the Arabian Peninsula to completely give up strikes against civilian infrastructure facilities . Russia’s position remains unchanged : there is no alternative to settling any crises in the region by political and diplomatic means while ensuring the interests of all the states in this region without exception.
